newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Roseanne behind King World upgrade.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Roseanne behind King World upgrade.

text.p: PaineWebber analyst Chris Dixon confirmed he upgraded the brokerage's rating of King World Productions Inc after the television syndicator hired actress and comedian Roseanne to host a daily talk show.
-- The stock was upgraded to attractive from neutral.

-- "The signing of Roseanne offsets concerns about whether Oprah will renew her contract. We have no way of knowing if she will, but if Roseanne is reasonably successful, it adequately discounts the potential departure of Oprah. And if Oprah stays, the stock could easily trade in the high 40's or low 50's," Dixon said.
